messages:
kevin: First day here! Finished Okta SSO and installed RedTunnel VPN but can't reach internal services like bastion.redwood.internal or registry.prod.redwood:5000. Client says "connected".

infra-bot: Welcome @kevin! Tagging @sophie (IT) and @netops. Onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood/onboarding/vpn-access. If you followed device trust we may still need to enroll you in the VPN-okta group.

sophie: Hi Kevin, welcome :) Are you on a company laptop or BYOD? Which OS and RedTunnel version? Also paste `netstat -rn | grep 10.` output if possible.

kevin: BYOD MacBook Air Ventura 13.7, RedTunnel 3.0.2 (installed from SSO). `netstat -rn | grep 10.` -> returns nothing. Client UI shows "Split tunnel: enabled".

anita: Split-tunnel usually means pushed internal routes/DNS didn't apply. Try `scutil --dns` to see if corporate DNS (10.50.0.10) is present. Also check if Okta shows device "Managed" or just "Trusted". BYOD can be "trusted" but not fully enrolled which triggers extra cert steps.

kevin: `scutil --dns` only lists my home ISP. Okta device status: Trusted (not Managed). How do we proceed?

sophie: Two immediate workarounds: 1) toggle "Route all traffic" in RedTunnel prefs temporarily (slower browsing), 2) we can open a short firewall window and let you SSH via public jump host while we fix pushes. Which do you want?

kevin: Can we do the jump host? I need to pull a docker image to finish local dev setup.

netops: Done  opened 30m firewall rule for your IP x.x.128.44 to bastion and registry. Use `ssh -J kevin@jump.pub.redwood ubuntu@10.50.2.6` to hop through. If SSH times out paste `ssh -v` output.

kevin: Trying SSH now... times out: "ssh: connect to host jump.pub.redwood port 22: Connection timed out"

anita: If jump.pub also doesn't resolve that's DNS not pushing. Try `dig jump.pub.redwood @10.50.0.10` to test internal DNS reachability.

kevin: `dig jump.pub.redwood @10.50.0.10` -> connection timed out. `dig jump.pub.redwood` -> NXDOMAIN.

netops: That confirms internal DNS isn't reachable. I'll push the 10.50.0.0/16 route and DNS 10.50.0.10 to the RedTunnel onboarding profile family. Some RedTunnel clients hide profile id in 3.0.x, so if that doesn't apply we may need logs. Pushing changes now, ETA ~5m.

anita: Also note: because you're BYOD and only Trusted, some PKI provisioning steps aren't automatic. If registry uses certs with internal SANs and your DNS leaks, you might hit cert CN mismatch. We'll keep an eye on that.

kevin: Policy pushed. Restarted RedTunnel, still no 10.* routes. `netstat -rn` unchanged. Logs show profile family `onboard-2028` but no profile id.

netops: Ah, your client build 3.0.2 requires explicit profile id for pushes. Can you do Help > Export Logs and DM them to me? I'll force-add the profile id mapping for your build. Also temporarily lowering tunnel MTU can help TLS hangs later: `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400`.

kevin: Uploaded logs to the ticket (ONB-6220). Thanks.

netops: Got them. Pushed profile id and forced policy refresh. Please reconnect.

kevin: Reconnected -> `netstat -rn | grep 10.` shows routes now, `dig bastion.redwood.internal @10.50.0.10` returns 10.50.1.7. SSH to bastion works.

kevin: But `docker pull registry.prod.redwood:5000/base:latest` hangs at TLS handshake. `curl -v https://registry.prod.redwood:5000/v2/` shows certificate common name registry.internal (name mismatch).

anita: Yep cert SAN mismatch. Short term use IP `https://10.50.3.9:5000`. We'll coordinate PKI to add `registry.prod.redwood` to SANs (ticket ONB-6221). Also try lowering MTU if TLS still stalls.

kevin: Using IP works after `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400`. Docker pull succeeded.

sophie: Great. Follow-up: I'll add you to the "VPN-Onboarded" Okta group so this persists and mark the onboarding ticket resolved. For future hires: company-managed devices are recommended since they auto-enroll and avoid the profile id/PKI steps; BYOD is allowed but please paste client version, `netstat` output, `scutil --dns`, and your public IP in the ticket to speed triage.

kevin: Super helpful, thanks everyone! :tada:
